snippet.title: Mario Tennis Fever – Opening Cinematic – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
The Mario Tennis Fever game launches Feb 12, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now: https://ninten.do/6002tNB20

Join Mario, Peach, Bowser, Daisy, and 34 other playable characters as they hit the court for explosive action in the latest Mario Tennis game!

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
